zh.summary: Miracly 是一个面向企业的 AI 搜索可见性平台，通过分析行业问题、生成并发布面向 AI 代理的结构化内容页，帮助品牌被 ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini 和 Perplexity 引用。
zh.judgment: 它把 GEO（生成式引擎优化）从一次性审计做成持续的内容生产与排名监控订阅，商业成立与否取决于客户能否把 AI 引用稳定转化为线索，而不仅是页面数量。
zh.replaces: 替代传统 SEO/GEO 代理的网站审计与人工内容外包，以及企业自行在官网博客中零散发布、无法追踪 AI 引用效果的做法。
zh.segment: AI 搜索可见性 / 生成式引擎优化（GEO）内容自动化
zh.product: 官网显示，Miracly 先抓取并审计客户网站，研究目标行业里人们向 AI 提出的高意图问题，再为每个问题生成约 1,500 词的结构化页面，包含服务定义、价格、本地语境、FAQ 与评价等代理可读事实。页面以独立内容页形式加在现有站点旁，不改动原网站，并通过 WordPress、Shopify、Squarespace、Next.js、React、Lovable、Webflow 等插件或 API 发布。平台还提供 AI 引用排名追踪、竞品广告与内容观察、社交帖子生成，以及每周对 ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini、Perplexity 的引用复查与自动改写。
zh.customer: 使用者是中小企业主与营销负责人，以及代运营多个品牌的代理商；付费者通常是企业营销预算持有人，代理商则按品牌订阅并向客户转售服务。痛点来自买家越来越多直接向 AI 提问并据此决策，企业却不知道自己在答案中是否出现、以何种事实被描述。官网引用的 Gartner 搜索量下降预测与 B2B 买家使用 AI 搜索的比例属于公司披露，未提供原始审计口径。
zh.workflow: 流程从输入网址开始：系统审计站点可抓取性，识别行业问题簇，按主题规划页面数量与发布节奏，再由模型以品牌语气和合规规则撰写页面，经仪表盘审批后按日发布到客户现有建站栈。之后平台持续追踪每个问题在多个 AI 引擎中的引用位置，被引用的页面保留，掉出引用的页面重写，从未被引用的页面退役。交付物是可索引的内容页集群、引用排名看板与周期性刷新，而非一次性报告。
zh.business_model: 定价页显示按月订阅，Starter、Pro、Scale 三档分别对应不同追踪提示词数量、页面上限、每日发布量和市场数，年付约省 5%，另有代理商方案与推荐佣金伙伴计划，企业版为定制报价。Claude、Perplexity、Grok 等在低档位属于加购项，合规模块与社交模块仅高档包含。单位经济未披露：每页的模型与抓取成本、客户留存和获客成本都未知，无法判断订阅毛利是否随页面量增长而被侵蚀。
zh.traction: 公开证据只有公司自述的一个案例：瑞典哥德堡油漆公司 Spektrum 在约 90 天内从 5 个索引页增至 1,140 个，Search Console 显示曝光与点击大幅增长，并称网站带来每日 5 至 10 条线索。这些数字由公司披露、来源标注为 Google Search Console，但未提供可独立核验的截图或第三方审计。客户总数、留存、退款率、代理商采用规模均未披露，不能据此推断产品已规模化验证。
zh.moat: 相对通用大模型，Miracly 的差异在于把问题研究、页面结构模板、多引擎引用追踪和自动刷新串成闭环，并接入主流建站栈降低发布摩擦；相对旧 SEO 流程，它把优化对象从关键词排名换成 AI 答案中的实体事实。壁垒条件是引用数据积累形成的反馈回路与发布集成广度，但这层能力可被模型厂商或 SEO 工具复制，真正的护城河需要靠客户线索结果与切换成本证明。
zh.funding_read: 本轮为 pre-seed，投资方包括 Beenext Ventures、Lotus 及多位天使与家族办公室，说明资金支持其把产品从早期形态推进到可重复获客。融资金额与原币由确定性层给出，资金用途未披露，不能推断用于团队扩张、模型成本还是销售。下一里程碑应是证明付费客户留存与 AI 引用到线索的转化，而非页面产量。
zh.risks: 第一，AI 引擎的引用机制与抓取政策可能变化，若平台大量低质页面被降权或屏蔽，客户结果会迅速恶化。第二，客户可能把曝光与引用误当收入，一旦线索不达预期便快速流失，订阅模式对留存极为敏感。第三，内容规模化发布存在搜索引擎惩罚与品牌合规风险，尤其在受监管行业。第四，定价档位以页面量为核心，若模型成本高企，高档客户的毛利可能被稀释。
zh.takeaway: 可借鉴之处是把新兴分发渠道的可见性做成可监控、可迭代的运营系统，而不是一次性咨询；同时用免费审计与免费试用降低决策门槛，用现有建站集成减少落地阻力。创业者应从一开始就定义与客户业务结果挂钩的指标，避免只卖页面数量。
zh.watch_next: 下一步应观察：付费客户数量与月度留存是否公开、Spektrum 类案例能否被第三方复核、AI 引用排名与客户线索之间的相关性数据、以及引擎政策变化时平台的应对机制。

en.summary: Miracly is an AI search visibility platform that studies the questions buyers ask AI, generates structured content pages, and publishes them so brands get cited by ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Perplexity.
en.judgment: It turns GEO from a one-off audit into a recurring content-production and rank-tracking subscription; whether the business holds depends on converting AI citations into leads, not on page volume.
en.replaces: Replaces traditional SEO/GEO agency audits and outsourced content writing, as well as ad-hoc blog posting that cannot track whether AI answers cite the brand.
en.segment: AI search visibility / generative engine optimization (GEO) content automation
en.product: According to the site, Miracly audits a customer's website, researches high-intent questions people ask AI in that industry, and writes roughly 1,500-word structured pages covering service definitions, pricing, local context, FAQs and reviews that agents can read. Pages are added alongside the existing site without changing it, and publish through WordPress, Shopify, Squarespace, Next.js, React, Lovable, Webflow plugins or an API. The platform also tracks citation positions across AI engines, observes competitor ads and content, drafts social posts, and re-checks pages weekly across ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Perplexity, rewriting pages that lose citations.
en.customer: Users are SMB owners and marketing leads, plus agencies running multiple brands; the payer is usually the marketing budget holder, while agencies subscribe per brand and resell the service. The pain is that buyers increasingly ask AI directly and act on the answer, yet businesses do not know whether they appear or which facts describe them. The Gartner search-decline forecast and B2B AI-search adoption figures on the site are company-reported and lack an audited methodology.
en.workflow: The workflow starts with a URL: the system audits crawlability, clusters industry questions, plans subjects and publishing cadence, then drafts pages in brand voice under tone and compliance rules. Pages are approved in a dashboard and published daily into the customer's existing stack. The platform then tracks each question's citation position across engines; cited pages are kept, slipping pages rewritten, and never-cited pages retired. Deliverables are an indexed page cluster, a citation dashboard and periodic refreshes rather than a one-off report.
en.business_model: The pricing page shows monthly subscriptions across Starter, Pro and Scale tiers differentiated by tracked prompts, page caps, daily publishing volume and markets, with about 5% off annual billing, an agency plan and a referral partner commission, plus custom enterprise pricing. Claude, Perplexity, Grok and others are add-ons at lower tiers, while compliance and social modules appear only at higher tiers. Unit economics are undisclosed: per-page model and crawling costs, retention and acquisition cost are unknown, so it is unclear whether gross margin erodes as page volume grows.
en.traction: Public evidence is one company-reported case: Spektrum Painting in Gothenburg grew from 5 indexed pages to 1,140 in about 90 days, with Search Console showing large impression and click gains and the owner claiming 5 to 10 leads per day. These figures are company-reported and attributed to Google Search Console but lack independently verifiable screenshots or third-party audit. Total customers, retention, refund rates and agency adoption are undisclosed, so scaled validation cannot be inferred.
en.moat: Versus general-purpose models, Miracly's differentiation is the closed loop of question research, page templates, multi-engine citation tracking and automatic refresh, plus integrations that reduce publishing friction. Versus legacy SEO, it optimizes for entity facts inside AI answers rather than keyword rankings. The barrier depends on a feedback loop built from citation data and breadth of publishing integrations, but model vendors or SEO suites could replicate this; a real moat needs proven lead outcomes and switching costs.
en.funding_read: This is a pre-seed round with Beenext Ventures, Lotus and several angels and a family office, indicating capital to move the product from early form toward repeatable acquisition. Amount and currency are rendered by the deterministic layer; use of funds is undisclosed, so it cannot be assumed to fund hiring, model costs or sales. The next milestone should be paid-customer retention and citation-to-lead conversion, not page output.
en.risks: First, AI engines' citation and crawling policies may change, and mass low-quality pages could be demoted or blocked, quickly worsening results. Second, customers may mistake impressions and citations for revenue and churn fast when leads disappoint, making the subscription highly retention-sensitive. Third, scaled publishing carries search-penalty and brand-compliance risk, especially in regulated sectors. Fourth, page-volume-based tiers may dilute margin on high-tier customers if model costs stay high.
en.takeaway: A transferable lesson is to turn visibility on a new distribution channel into a monitored, iterable operating system rather than one-off consulting, while using free audits and trials to lower decision friction and existing site integrations to reduce rollout effort. Founders should define metrics tied to customer business outcomes from day one instead of selling page counts.
en.watch_next: Watch whether paid customer counts and monthly retention are disclosed, whether Spektrum-style cases can be independently verified, whether citation rankings correlate with customer leads, and how the platform adapts when engine policies change.

evidence.text: Miracly's AI-powered marketing platform helps businesses monitor and improve their visibility across AI search engines, automate marketing activities and identify new growth opportunities.
